Job Title: Data Scientist

Job Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Job Summary

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required â your domain knowledge is what matters.

Key Responsibilities

OWL Services is the premier sales, installation, program management and service provider to retail, commercial, fleet, aviation and marine, and emergency power generation companies across the U.S.

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Warehouse & BI team and help us expand the reach, depth, and operational impact of our modern data platform. This is a hands-on role focused on report development, model expansion, and the ongoing reliability of a production analytics stack that already drives company-wide reporting.

You will work closely with stakeholders across the business, including operations, finance, dispatch, inventory, vendor management, and others. jobs.title: New Graduate Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

NEW GRADUATE ENGINEER, INFRASTRUCTURE

SpaceX is looking for a New Graduate Mechanical Engineer to help build the infrastructure behind power generation and supercompute at Starbase. You will support mechanical scope from concept through design, fabrication, construction, and commissioning. The work can span power generation, fluid and cooling systems, and the structures and equipment that production depends on. You will work across engineering, construction, and operations, and see your work show up in hardware that has to perform in the field. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop design concepts and help size infrastructure systems based on operational loads, site conditions, and how the facility will actually run
  • Collaborate with peers across disciplines to develop designs that balance cost, schedule, reliability, and capability
  • Create detailed designs and generate CAD models and prints for components, assemblies, and integration into the larger site
  • Build analysis models to assess designs and confirm they meet the needs of the system
  • Apply first-order hand calculations and empirical formulas to assess and iterate on designs rapidly
  • Support validation through development hardware, mockups, or first articles, and testing of critical joints, components, and design elements
  • Support testing and commissioning of subsystems and full installations
  • Partner with construction, build engineers, and technicians to improve designs and resolve issues found during build and installation
  • Support installation of hardware in the field, witness designs being built and brought online, and see them go into service
  • Participate in design reviews and help move designs from development into installed hardware

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Graduating with a bachelor's degree, master's degree, or PhD in 2026 or 2027
  • Degree in an engineering discipline or physics
  • 1+ years of mechanical design, analysis, build, or test experience via project team, research, internships, and/or professional experience

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
